title: Re-entry — structural placeholder
description: Organizational outline for a renewed encounter or relation after interruption or exit; not a new constitutional category or automatic resumption.
$comment: Annotation-only placeholder: accepts every instance; no conformance or constitutional effect is established.

prior_relation.description: Exact earlier relation and its historical scope.

interruption_or_exit.description: Supported closure, withdrawal, or interruption, without erasing its history.

new_occurrence.description: Exact renewed encounter or act; prior participation does not establish current Presence.

present_binding.description: Attributable current binding supplied by the relevant Locality's own qualifying act or an exact valid representation of it.

local_bases.description: Valid local bases for the relation attributed to each relevant side.

scope.description: What is newly supported and what remains historical, ended, or unestablished.

motion_relations.description: Present relations independently required if consequential motion is resumed.

uncertainty.description: Open questions without presumed restored consent, succession, or Authority.
